description: This file declares classes and methods related to OpenGL transform feedback functionality within the ANGLE project, including state management and implementation details.

classes.name: TransformFeedbackState
classes.description: Manages the state of a transform feedback object, including buffers, program, and drawing statistics.

classes.name: TransformFeedback
classes.description: Represents a transform feedback object with methods to control its lifecycle and state.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Starts transform feedback with specified primitive mode and program.

methods.name: onVerticesDrawn
methods.description: Updates internal counters after vertices are drawn.

methods.name: bindIndexedBuffer
methods.description: Binds a buffer to a specific index for transform feedback.

methods.name: detachBuffer
methods.description: Detaches a buffer from the transform feedback object.
